import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load libraries with correct order
cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl_lib = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define necessary GSL types and functions
class gsl_vector(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("size", ctypes.c_size_t), ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), ("stride", ctypes.c_size_t)]

class gsl_matrix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("size1", ctypes.c_size_t), ("size2", ctypes.c_size_t), ("tda", ctypes.c_size_t), ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), ("block", ctypes.c_void_p), ("owner", ctypes.c_int)]

class gsl_bspline_workspace(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Set up function prototype
gsl_bspline_gram_func = gsl_lib.gsl_bspline_gram
gsl_bspline_gram_func.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_matrix), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_bspline_workspace)]
gsl_bspline_gram_func.restype = ctypes.c_int

def compute_gram_matrix(nderiv, G_matrix, w_workspace):
    """Compute Gram matrix for B-spline basis functions."""
    return gsl_bspline_gram_func(nderiv, ctypes.byref(G_matrix), ctypes.byref(w_workspace))
